summary: On 12 November 2026, Russia launched a massive combined missile and drone attack across at least 13 Ukrainian regions, including Kyiv, where ballistic missiles struck the northern bridge and a drone with anti-personnel shrapnel fell on a residential street. Simultaneously, President Zelensky reported systematic Starshield/Starlink speed limitations to 161 km/h along the entire front line for several days, which he stated assists Russian targeting. Heavy fighting continues near Kostyantynivka and Bilytske in Donetsk region.
key_points: Russia launched Shahed-type strike UAVs and reactive UAVs from Orel (4 groups), Bryansk (4 groups), and Millerovo (1 group) on 12 November 2026. (Source: @eRadarrua/130402)
Two ballistic missiles targeted Kyiv, with three impacts reported on the northern bridge. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78149, @mon1tor_ua/78146)
A Russian drone that fell in Kyiv was equipped with shrapnel warhead designed to maximize civilian casualties. (Source: @eRadarrua/130401)

President Zelensky confirmed systematic Starshield speed limitations to 161 km/h along the entire front line and occupied territories for several days, degrading Ukrainian C4ISR. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23996)
Geran-5 missiles struck Vinnytsia city and Rivne region, with one missile running out of fuel over Vinnytsia. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78176, @mon1tor_ua/78178)
Three Banderyol cruise missiles launched from Mykolaiv region toward Odesa region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78165)
Russian forces advanced near Bilytske in Donetsk region while active battles continue for Kostyantynivka, which remains under Ukrainian control. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23998, @DeepStateUA/23997)

Ukrenergo reported a massive crater at an energy substation from a Russian strike, noting intensified Russian attacks on energy infrastructure using reactive drones and ballistic missiles. (Source: @eRadarrua/130283)
